topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Hey there! I just heard the news about your best friend moving across the country. I know it can feel like a bit of a rollercoaster, but let's think about all the fun ways you can keep that connection strong. Maybe you can start a tradition of monthly movie nights, where you both watch the same film and chat about it afterward. Or how about planning a big visit for the holidays? It’s a whole new adventure for both of you, and it’s amazing to see how friendships can grow in different ways. There are so many neat things you can do to stay close, and it’s exciting to explore all the possibilities together!
